targetText: Hegel's dialectics, which Marx placed on its feet, is valuable for this very reason that it grasps the dialectics of life, that it fearlessly analyses the present without being disturbed by the fact that every existence hides within itself the germ of its own destruction.
summary: Placed on materialist feet by Marx, dialectics reveals that every historical social form contains the internal contradictions that lead to its overthrow.
explanation: Contrasting Marx's materialist dialectic with Hegel's mystified idealist form, Bukharin concludes that the sharpening contradictions of finance capitalism inevitably prepare the bursting of the capitalist shell.
